caseName: Bay Area Laundry & Dry Cleaning Pension Trust Fund v. Ferbar Corp. of California
caseNameFull: Bay Area Laundry and Dry Cleaning Pension Trust Fund v. Ferbar Corporation of California, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motions of National Coordinating Committee for Multiemployer Plans and Central States, Southeast and Southwest Areas Pension Fund for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief in this case expressing the views of the United States.
